

# 🚀 Junkyard Magnet: Magnetic Madness!

## How to Play  
Control the magnetic robot with **WASD**. Use **E** to attract metal objects and **R** to repel them. Navigate the junkyard, solve puzzles, and reach the exit before time runs out! Collect objects for points and manage your magnet energy.

**Note:** Autonomously generated by NightCode. No magic, just code!
